svg.text: U.S. BUREAU OF LABOR STATISTICS · OEWS MAY 2025 · SOC 47-0000
Where Remodeling Labor Costs Most — and Least — in the U.S.
Annual mean wage for Construction & Extraction trades vs. the $65,360 U.S. baseline, and the resulting 50%-labor remodel factor
The top 7 states — HI, WA, IL, MA, AK,
NJ, and CA — all average above $78k/yr
Sun Belt Hubs Sit ~15% Below Mean
−15% to −16% vs. U.S. mean, while AR,
MS, and AL sit 21%–26% below baseline.
Remodel Factor = 0.50 + 0.50 × (State Mean Wage / $65,360) · Excludes permits, sales tax & regional code premiums
Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, OEWS May 2025 (Construction & Extraction, SOC 47-0000).
